title: Pure Reptilianne
summary: Reptilianne cards only, with generic Links and staples. Reptilianne turns the opponent's monsters to 0 ATK and then cashes them in. The 2021 cards lead. Reptilianne Nyami discards itself on either turn to zero a monster and comes back from the GY while they control one. Reptilianne Coatl summons itself next to a DARK Reptile, plus one more Reptilianne for every 0-ATK monster they control. Reptilianne Ramifications pays a discard for two of a monster search, a Spell/Trap search or a zeroed monster. Reptilianne Recoil steals a 0-ATK monster when they activate a monster effect. Reptilianne Melusine, made from only Reptiles, can't be destroyed and zeroes a monster whenever they activate a monster effect. Reptilianne Echidna searches one Reptile per 0-ATK monster, Reptilianne Vaskii tributes two 0-ATK monsters from either field, and Reptilianne Viper takes one.
